He also shared a number of experiences and insights relating to strategic planning, security and defence. The lecture featured an engaging discussion and interaction with the College’s personnel, contributing to an exchange of knowledge and expertise on Singapore’s defence experience. Since the start of the ceasefire, COGAT has coordinated the entry of essential humanitarian aid into Gaza, working alongside the UN, international organizations, and donor countries. Using established coordination mechanisms, COGAT facilitates the delivery of various supplies and equipment on a weekly basis. This week, as part of these efforts to strengthen the humanitarian response in the Gaza Strip, COGAT coordinated the movement of hundreds of pallets of aid into Gaza. Among these shipments were: 💊 Chlorine tablets shipped by the @IOM 🫁 CPAP devices by @UNICEF 🔧 Generator spare parts by @UNDSS 🩺 Ultrasound devices by the @WHO 🧪 Medical laboratory equipment by the @WHO 💧 Water containers by the @ICRC COGAT coordinates the entry of this equipment together with the international community to strengthen the medical and WASH response on the ground. Israel remains committed to the coordination of humanitarian aid to ensure the appropriate medical, nutritional, and WASH response remains available to the Gazan civilian population.

Under the directives of Mohammed bin Rashid, Dubai Humanitarian facilitates a new air bridge to deliver urgent WHO medical and health supplies to the people of Gaza. The first flight departed two days ago carrying 11 metric tonnes of essential medicines, followed by three additional flights carrying medical supplies, medicines, tents and fortified biscuits. The four flights form part of a wider operation through which Dubai Humanitarian will facilitate the delivery of around 150 metric tonnes of WHO medical and health supplies to Gaza in the coming weeks.
